title: LLM-typical AI-prose / linguistic tells
author: WinstonRedGuard -- sigma plugin ai-fingerprint observed rules
description:
Detects linguistic AI-prose tells in code comments, docstrings, and string literals: em-dash density excess above the human-prose baseline (3.83/1k words; Claude ~9/1k), AI-vocabulary words (delve, tapestry, meticulous, ...), multi-word boilerplate phrases (at its core, it is worth noting, ...), rule-of-three structural patterns, and inline-bold-list items. Fires only on dense co-occurrence (2+ distinct tell kinds) to suppress single-signal false positives. Weight 0.20 / max-confidence 0.80 -- linguistic tells are inherently low-certainty and are best interpreted together with structural detector signals.

Aggregated from 2 fingerprint hit(s) across 1 file(s). Sample paths: apps/foo/bar.py.
